sentences.text: Our cash and cash equivalents decreased by $59.49 billion to $182.09 billion at the end of 2024, primarily due to net cash used for investing activities and operating activities, partially offset by financing activities.

The net cash used for investing activities primarily reflected net purchases of U.S. government obligations accounted for as available-for-sale securities and an increase in net lending activities (reflecting increases in other collateralized loans).
Cash and cash equivalents decreased $43.0 billion primarily driven by reinvestment of cash into debt securities.

comparisons.peer_topic: Financing activities sources and uses of cash
comparisons.peer_summary: In 2024, the Firm's financing activities provided cash primarily through higher securities loaned or sold under repurchase agreements and net proceeds from borrowings, offset by preferred stock redemptions, while in 2023 cash was used due to lower deposits including First Republic repayment, offset by higher securities lending and borrowing proceeds. For both periods, cash was used for common stock repurchases and cash dividends.
comparisons.comparison: Both GS and JPM detailed the components of their financing activities, noting that these activities provided cash which helped offset operating and investing outflows. GS cited inflows from secured financings and deposits. JPM cited cash provided primarily from higher securities loaned/sold under repurchase agreements and net proceeds from borrowings. Both also noted outflows from stock repurchases, though GS explicitly mentioned stock repurchases as an offset to financing inflows.

sentences.text: The net cash provided by financing activities primarily reflected cash inflows from other secured financings and deposits (reflecting increases in consumer deposits, partially offset by decreases in transaction banking deposits and other deposits), partially offset by common stock repurchases and net repayments of unsecured long-term borrowings.

• In 2024, cash provided primarily reflected higher securities loaned or sold under repurchase agreements and net proceeds from long- and short-term borrowings, partially offset by net redemption of preferred stock.
• For both periods, cash was used for repurchases of common stock and cash dividends on common and preferred stock.
